title: Melody of the Night
description: A black silhouette of a woman with long flowing green hair adorned with purple flowers sits at a grand piano. Musical notes flow from the piano and her hair into a surreal night landscape featuring a glowing domed building on a hill, two large floating cat heads with glowing eyes and sharp teeth, under a vibrant purple and blue sky with clouds and birds.
prompt: A surreal night scene with a black silhouette woman whose long green hair is braided with purple flowers and musical notes, playing a grand piano. Blue musical staves and notes flow from the piano. In the background, a glowing white domed temple sits on a green hill under a dramatic purple and blue sky. Two large floating black cat heads with glowing patterned eyes and wide toothy grins hover in the sky. Stylized clouds, birds, and swirling blue energy fill the composition.
